column3: SWAP TO SPECTRAL SLASH — everything below assumes the swap is done

Spectral Slash - Legion - Detonation - Critical Strike Damage Increase + Quick Decision / Added Phys
3x Activation Medium: one each for Spectral Slash / the warcries / Ice Bond (the Frostbite self-applicator)
All 4 Precise Auras: Cruelty (+Disciplined) - Fearless - Domain Expansion - Frigid Domain

Red Umbrella + Azure Gunslinger (+48% Attack Damage, +16% Attack Speed each; nodes 4-6 are pure crit)
Captain Kitty of the Furious Sea (+12% Warcry Effect, “Beast” Roar)
KITTY IS THE ONLY PACTSPIRIT WORTH LEVELLING (L2 warcry CDR, L3 a warcry charge)

Grace Boots — KEEP until the Focus Blessing slate (see SLATE PRIORITY below)
Bodhi Girdle
Vortex Heart (~130 FE)

3-4x SLATE 1mod + full reveal:
+1 Attack skill level
+1 Physical skill level (not the no-conversion one)
+1 to all skill
10% additional damage for 4s after using Mobility skills

PEDIGREE (~30 FE, snipe one). Best cores it can roll:
Steady Accumulation (+40%) — +40% additional Hit Damage
Focused Strike (+32%) — Area Skills deal up to +32% additional damage to enemies at the center
Survival Will (+30%) — +30% additional Attack Damage when not at Low Life
Rushed (+30%) — +30% additional damage if you have recently moved more than 5 m
Blunt (+30%) — +30% additional Physical Damage
Great Strength (+26.49%) — -10% Attack Speed
Judgment (+25%) — +100% chance for Attacks to inflict Paralysis on hit
Frozen Lotus (+25%) — +25% additional Cold Damage
STANDING WATCHLIST — CHECK AH EVERY SESSION. BUY ON PRICE, NOT ON SCHEDULE.
Heart of Animitta — snipe it WAY under list. +1 Finisher charge = a second full-power finisher every sequence, +80% Finisher Amplification. THE #1 BUY ON THIS SHEET.
Vorax boot base — i86 or above with at least one decent mod (the vessel for Have Fervor)
Dawn Break belt — supplies “Have Fervor” onto the Vorax boots. Dead without the base above.
Ghost Slaughter — THE CORRODED 1%/pt ROLL ONLY (normal roll is a third of the value). Dead slot until the Vorax boots hold Fervor — buy the engine, not the glove.
Eternity — DO NOT pay the ~4k FE item price; buy the 5 BLUEPRINTS instead. Kill-fed stacks = a mapping monster, and it pays the Fervor sustain bill.
i100 Timid curse-on-hit ring — frees the warcry bar slot and carries its own ×1.39 boss layer. Monitor continuously once Traveler 8 is done.
Inverse Prism (Brave tree) — want POSITIVE Legendary-Medium AND Medium effect ranges (+38%/+17% roll modeled). Copies +6 min warcry enemies — floor 14 of the 16-stack cap.
Ethereal Prism: Unmatched Valor — fixed 130 Fervor Rating. NEEDS the i100 sealed-mana helmet + Dawn Break first (Ranger slot). God roll: “no longer replaces” keeps the Ranger core too.
i86 CORE — IN THIS ORDER. PRICELESS WAITS UNTIL AFTER TRAVELER 8.

i86 mainhand — Shadowless Swordsman's Blade, speed/crit roll.
Lines in order: T1 flat Cold (+17.1%) > gear Attack Speed (+8.2%) > flat Phys (+5.9%)
Advanced ember: Gear Phys% (+9%, 3x cost). SKIP the crit-rating line (+0.3%).

i86 offhand — same base, raw damage roll.
Lines: flat Cold (+5.1%) > Elemental% (+2.6%) > flat Phys / Phys%
Advanced: Gear Phys% / Crit Damage (~+2.5% each)

i86 ring, frostbite roll — THE +1 COMBO POINTS SUFFIX IS THE ITEM, NEVER LOSE IT.
The second (barrier) ring is only +1.2% → +2.6% — lowest priority in this gate.

Hero Memory LEGENDARY
REVIVED #% Attack Speed for every main attack skill cast
Base Affix: Strength / ES / Attack Speed
Fixed Affix: %ES
Random Affix: Phys/Cold Crit Damage / Phys/Cold/Attack Crit Rating / Attack Speed / Cold Damage / Damage

2x Peerless + Tiger's Chain — the Dual pair is +1 Finisher charge + fixed 0.3s sequence reset; never move these
2x Mammoth + Ascetic — Mammoth pair self-casts Lv.20 Resurrection Warcry on hit every 3s
Fill the rest: 1x Medium + 9x Micro Crit Rating
i86 chest = defense/ES only — buy it for survivability, don't chase damage lines here.
SLATE PRIORITY — buy in this order
Focus Blessing on Frostbitten hit (God of Knowledge line) — REQUIRED BEFORE THE i86 BOOTS: it unlocks the whole boots ladder (Grace Boots freed → i86 → Dawn Break).
Frostbite on Cold hit (Frostbitten core / Prophet line) — frees 4 Prophet tree points; respec them into the Frostbite legendaries (Effect / Cold Infiltration / more-vs-Frozen).
+4 min enemies affected by Warcry (The Brave, 1 copy) — floors the boss stack count at 8 of 16; the Inverse Prism copy adds 4-6 more.

Phys→Cold conversion slate — the Prophet tree already covers conversion today. Buying the slate frees the Prophet → Ronin respec (re-cover conversion, then Cold Infiltration on Frozen / Frostbite Effect first).

A Corner of Divinity (max 3) — rolls 2x Legendary Medium, any god
Fallen Starlight (max 3) — 3x Micro + 1x Medium/Legendary Medium
Pedigree of Gods (max 1) — the Core Talent carrier (see the pedigree row above)
God slates — 2 fixed + 3 random; aim 1x Medium + 2x Legendary Medium or better

Best rollable Legendary Medium fillers beyond the plan:
+20% Frostbite Effect (+11.04%)
+1 to All Skills' Levels (+10.64%)
+1 to Attack Skill Level (+10%)
+10% additional damage against Frozen enemies (+10%)
+1 Physical Skill Level (+10%)
+1 Persistent Skill Level (+10%)
Skill-level lines STACK across slates — the build runs four +1 Attack Skill Level.

Hold the immunity Legendary Mediums before farming Deep Space:
Immune to Ignite (Warlord) / Immune to Trauma (Shadowdancer) / Immune to Wilt (Shadowmaster)
i86 ARMOR PIECES
i86 ES boots — ONLY AFTER the Focus Blessing slate above (they drop Grace Boots' trigger). Get the Hasten line + Crit Rating / Crit Damage.
i86 ES helmet — Crit Rating basic, Strength + Crit Damage advanced.
i86 ES gloves — %damage + Crit Rating basics, Crit Damage advanced.
PRICELESS SHOPPING OPENS NOW — check 8-1/8-2 pieces EVERY session and buy on price. Timid ring joins the standing watchlist (see above).
PRICELESS COMPLETES (8-1 + 8-2 open)
PRICELESS mainhand — ultimate lines: Armor Mitigation Penetration (+5.2%) / Combo Damage Enhancement (+5.2%); basics: gear Attack Speed (+6.8%) + flat Phys.

i100 offhand — Ninth Apostle's Magic Shield. +4 Active Skill Level (+10%) is the big line, plus Warcry Effect + Strength.
Lands as a PACKAGE with i86 Hasten boots + God of Might / Brave tree changes.
i100 Timid curse-on-hit ring — from the watchlist; frees the warcry slot, ×1.39 boss layer.
i100 second ring, phys-as-extra roll — Fervor Effect + Elemental/Erosion Pen ultimates.

THE FERVOR ENGINE — buy as ONE purchase; any piece alone is a dead slot.
COST: 12% of current Life AND ES per second while Fervor is active — sustain is INSIDE this bundle, not next to it.
Dawn Break belt onto the Vorax boot base (both from the watchlist) — +1% additional damage per 2 rating + 78% Crit Damage. Range = boots alone → with the tree change.
Corroded Ghost Slaughter (watchlist) — +1% additional damage per rating.
i100 sealed-mana helmet — near-zero alone, the range lands with the fixed-rating prism. Craft Sealed Mana Compensation ultimate.
Ethereal Prism: Unmatched Valor — fixed 130 Fervor Rating in the Ranger slot (over the 100 cap, immune to Centralize swings; Centralize becomes a respec candidate).

Eternity (from the 5 blueprints) + Precise: Energy Shield support once the flat-ES belt is gone.
Resurrection Warcry in the second warcry slot (or let the Mammoth kismets self-cast it).
ENDGAME LAYERS

Fervor spent twice: native +2% Crit Rating per point AND the 0.5% Crit Damage per rating converters (tree legendary + two slate copies) = +195% Crit Damage at 130 rating.
Support bar: Critical Strike Damage Increase stays over a plain damage support.

Shockwave Warcry onto the slot the Timid ring freed; level Captain Kitty.
Inverse Prism good roll (+90.44%) — floor 14 of 16 warcry stacks.
MIRROR-WORTHY mainhand — only worth it for the +4 Attack Skill Level roll (+10%); otherwise priceless is the stop.
